<!-- Author: Kunru Song -->

This sensitivity analysis evaluates whether the primary mlVAR networks are
materially influenced by systematic patterns tied to the 90 scheduled
observation positions. In `mlVAR 0.6.1`, `full_detrend = TRUE` standardizes
each node separately at each observation position across participants before
the ordinary global scaling and network estimation. In this balanced
three-prompts-per-day design, the procedure therefore removes shared
position-specific mean and variance patterns, including broad study-day,
assessment-occasion, and their potentially nonlinear or interactive structure.
This is a package-native detrending sensitivity, not an exact reproduction of
the DSEM adjustment for a centered linear Day term plus two categorical Time
contrasts: full detrending is broader and changes both position-specific means
and scales. The model below otherwise reproduces the S5.2 primary mlVAR
specification exactly, so the comparison isolates the package's
`full_detrend` preprocessing choice. The rationale follows the stationarity
considerations described for GVAR models by
[Epskamp et al. (2018)](https://doi.org/10.1080/00273171.2018.1454823) and the
installed `mlVAR 0.6.1` help for `mlVAR()`.

The primary `full_detrend = FALSE` model remains canonical. This report is a
descriptive sensitivity analysis and does not replace S5.2, its bootstrap
results, or the Step 6 bridge results reported in the manuscript.

This analysis is included in the public repository for transparency and is
not reported in the manuscript or supplementary materials.

```{r load-saved-report, include=FALSE, eval=use_saved_results}
# Optional report-only mode: validate and display saved outputs without refitting
# or rewriting any RDA/workbook. Default rendering still runs the complete code.
fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar <- load_single_object(primary_fit_file, "fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar")
fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend <- load_single_object(fit_file, "fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend")
results_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend_comparison <- load_single_object(
  comparison_result_file, "results_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend_comparison"
)
saved_fit <- fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend
saved_comparison <- results_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend_comparison
file_md5 <- function(path) unname(tools::md5sum(path))
stopifnot(
  identical(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$provenance$input_md5, file_md5(input_file)),
  identical(saved_fit$provenance$input_md5, file_md5(input_file)),
  identical(saved_fit$provenance$primary_fit_md5, file_md5(primary_fit_file)),
  identical(saved_comparison$provenance$primary_fit_md5, file_md5(primary_fit_file)),
  identical(saved_comparison$provenance$full_detrend_fit_md5, file_md5(fit_file)),
  all(saved_fit$fatal_gate$passed), all(saved_comparison$comparison_gate$passed),
  isFALSE(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$full_detrend),
  isTRUE(saved_fit$model$input$full_detrend)
)
saved_workbook_md5 <- file_md5(table_file)
if (!identical(saved_comparison$workbook_audit$md5, saved_workbook_md5)) {
  # A workbook can be resaved without changing its table values. In that case
  # compare every column with the owner script's six-decimal export, not merely
  # the file checksum. No workbook content or saved provenance is rewritten.
  expected_sheets <- c(list(Summary = saved_comparison$network_summary),
                       saved_comparison$edge_comparisons)
  stopifnot(identical(readxl::excel_sheets(table_file), names(expected_sheets)))
  for (sheet in names(expected_sheets)) {
    expected <- round_numeric_columns(expected_sheets[[sheet]], digits = 6L)
    actual <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(table_file, sheet = sheet))
    stopifnot(identical(names(actual), names(expected)), nrow(actual) == nrow(expected))
    for (column in names(expected)) {
      if (is.numeric(expected[[column]])) {
        stopifnot(is.numeric(actual[[column]]),
                  isTRUE(all.equal(actual[[column]], expected[[column]],
                                   tolerance = 1e-10, check.attributes = FALSE)))
      } else {
        stopifnot(identical(as.character(actual[[column]]), as.character(expected[[column]])))
      }
    }
  }
  stopifnot(identical(file_md5(table_file), saved_workbook_md5))
}
model_specification <- saved_fit$model_specification
expected_sensitivity_specification <- fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model_specification

fatal_diagnostics <- saved_fit$fatal_gate
```

# Load and validate the S5.1 entry and S5.2 primary fit

```{r load-data, eval=!use_saved_results}
dat_step5_mlvar <- load_single_object(input_file, "dat_step5_mlvar")
fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar <- load_single_object(
  primary_fit_file, "fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar"
)
node_names <- dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$node

stopifnot(
  identical(
    names(dat_step5_mlvar),
    c("prompt", "node_map", "layout", "scaling", "sample_audit", "diagnostics", "provenance")
  ),
  length(node_names) == 12L,
  nrow(dat_step5_mlvar$prompt) == 18810L,
  sum(dat_step5_mlvar$prompt$lag1_complete) == 16598L,
  inherits(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model, "mlVAR"),
  isFALSE(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$full_detrend),
  identical(
    dat_step5_mlvar$provenance$overnight_rule,
    "Primary model retains overnight transitions; no exclusion sensitivity planned"
  )
)

model_data <- dat_step5_mlvar$prompt |>
  dplyr::select(Name_ID, occasion, dplyr::all_of(node_names)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Name_ID, occasion) |>
  as.data.frame()

stopifnot(
  nrow(model_data) == 18810L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(model_data$Name_ID) == 209L,
  !anyNA(model_data[c("Name_ID", "occasion")]),
  !anyDuplicated(model_data[c("Name_ID", "occasion")]),
  all(tapply(model_data$occasion, model_data$Name_ID, function(x) identical(x, 1:90)))
)

input_audit <- data.frame(
  scheduled_rows = nrow(model_data),
  participants = dplyr::n_distinct(model_data$Name_ID),
  complete_12_node_occasions = sum(stats::complete.cases(model_data[node_names])),
  expected_usable_lag1_rows = sum(dat_step5_mlvar$prompt$lag1_complete),
  s5_1_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(input_file)),
  s5_2_fit_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(primary_fit_file)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(input_audit)
```


# Matched sensitivity specification and estimation

All arguments reproduce S5.2: `lags = 1`, `estimator = "lmer"`, orthogonal
temporal and contemporaneous random effects, global scaling without
person-specific SD scaling, transition-level complete-case estimation, a
global `occasion` beep, and no supplied `dayvar`. The only scientific setting
changed is `full_detrend = TRUE`; overnight transitions therefore remain in
the model exactly as in S5.2.

```{r fit-full-detrend, cache=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
model_specification <- data.frame(
  argument = c(
    "vars", "idvar", "beepvar", "dayvar", "lags", "estimator",
    "temporal", "contemporaneous", "scale", "scaleWithin",
    "na.rm", "full_detrend", "overnight_exclusion_sensitivity"
  ),
  value = c(
    paste(node_names, collapse = ", "), "Name_ID", "occasion", "Not supplied",
    "1", "lmer", "orthogonal", "orthogonal", "TRUE", "FALSE",
    "TRUE", "TRUE", "Not planned"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

expected_sensitivity_specification <- fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model_specification
expected_sensitivity_specification$value[
  expected_sensitivity_specification$argument == "full_detrend"
] <- "TRUE"
stopifnot(identical(model_specification, expected_sensitivity_specification))

set.seed(52102L)
requested_cores <- min(13L, parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE))
fit_start <- Sys.time()
full_detrend_model <- mlVAR::mlVAR(
  data = model_data,
  vars = node_names,
  idvar = "Name_ID",
  beepvar = "occasion",
  lags = 1,
  estimator = "lmer",
  temporal = "orthogonal",
  contemporaneous = "orthogonal",
  nCores = requested_cores,
  verbose = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE,
  scaleWithin = FALSE,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  full_detrend = TRUE
)
fit_end <- Sys.time()

timing <- data.frame(
  started = format(fit_start, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
  finished = format(fit_end, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
  elapsed_seconds = as.numeric(difftime(fit_end, fit_start, units = "secs")),
  requested_cores = requested_cores,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(model_specification)
knitr::kable(timing, digits = 2)
```

```{r saved-fit-display, echo=FALSE, eval=use_saved_results}
knitr::kable(model_specification)
knitr::kable(timing, digits = 2)
```

# Mixed-model and network diagnostics

```{r diagnostics, eval=!use_saved_results}
names(full_detrend_model$output$temporal) <- node_names
names(full_detrend_model$output$contemporaneous) <- node_names

temporal_diagnostics <- lmer_diagnostic_table(
  full_detrend_model$output$temporal, node_names, "Temporal/between"
)
contemporaneous_diagnostics <- lmer_diagnostic_table(
  full_detrend_model$output$contemporaneous, node_names, "Contemporaneous"
)
model_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  temporal_diagnostics, contemporaneous_diagnostics
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    boundary_singularity_message = grepl(
      "boundary (singular) fit", convergence_message, fixed = TRUE
    ),
    nonboundary_convergence_message = nzchar(convergence_message) &
      !boundary_singularity_message
  )

fixed_effect_covariance <- list(
  temporal = stats::setNames(
    lapply(full_detrend_model$output$temporal, stats::vcov), node_names
  ),
  contemporaneous = stats::setNames(
    lapply(full_detrend_model$output$contemporaneous, stats::vcov), node_names
  )
)

matrices <- extract_mlvar_matrices(full_detrend_model)
validate_network_matrix(matrices$temporal, node_names, symmetric = FALSE)
validate_network_matrix(matrices$contemporaneous, node_names, symmetric = TRUE)
validate_network_matrix(matrices$between, node_names, symmetric = TRUE)

spectral_radius <- matrix_spectral_radius(t(matrices$temporal))
distress_between_correlation <-
  dat_step5_mlvar$diagnostics$distress_between_correlation
distress_between_eigenvalues <- eigen(
  distress_between_correlation, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE
)$values

network_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  diagnostic = c(
    "Rows used by mlVAR augmented data",
    "Participants used",
    "Temporal models",
    "Contemporaneous models",
    "Models with optimizer code != 0",
    "Models with boundary-singularity messages",
    "Models with nonboundary convergence messages",
    "Models singular at 1e-4",
    "Models singular at 1e-6",
    "Models with nonfinite fixed effects",
    "Fixed temporal spectral radius",
    "Minimum eigenvalue of S5.1 Distress person-mean correlation",
    "Condition number of S5.1 Distress person-mean correlation"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(full_detrend_model$data),
    dplyr::n_distinct(full_detrend_model$data$Name_ID),
    length(full_detrend_model$output$temporal),
    length(full_detrend_model$output$contemporaneous),
    sum(model_diagnostics$optimizer_code != 0L),
    sum(model_diagnostics$boundary_singularity_message),
    sum(model_diagnostics$nonboundary_convergence_message),
    sum(model_diagnostics$singular_1e4),
    sum(model_diagnostics$singular_1e6),
    sum(!model_diagnostics$finite_fixed_effects),
    spectral_radius,
    min(distress_between_eigenvalues),
    kappa(distress_between_correlation)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

fatal_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  criterion = c(
    "All 24 node-wise mixed models returned",
    "All models used the exact 16,598 lag-1 rows",
    "All 209 participants retained",
    "No nonzero optimizer termination code",
    "No nonboundary lme4 convergence message",
    "All fixed effects finite",
    "All three network matrices finite",
    "Contemporaneous and between matrices symmetric",
    "Fixed temporal system has spectral radius below one"
  ),
  passed = c(
    nrow(model_diagnostics) == 24L,
    all(model_diagnostics$observations == 16598L),
    all(model_diagnostics$groups == 209L),
    all(model_diagnostics$optimizer_code == 0L),
    all(!model_diagnostics$nonboundary_convergence_message),
    all(model_diagnostics$finite_fixed_effects),
    all(vapply(
      matrices[c("temporal", "contemporaneous", "between")],
      function(x) all(is.finite(x)), logical(1)
    )),
    isTRUE(all.equal(matrices$contemporaneous, t(matrices$contemporaneous), tolerance = 1e-8)) &&
      isTRUE(all.equal(matrices$between, t(matrices$between), tolerance = 1e-8)),
    is.finite(spectral_radius) && spectral_radius < 1
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(network_diagnostics, digits = 6)
knitr::kable(model_diagnostics, digits = 6)
knitr::kable(fatal_diagnostics)
if (!all(fatal_diagnostics$passed)) {
  print(fatal_diagnostics)
  stop("S5.7 full-detrend fatal diagnostic gate failed")
}
```

As in S5.2, singular random-effect fits and boundary variance estimates are
reported as model diagnostics and do not by themselves prompt post-hoc changes to the fixed network specification.

```{r saved-diagnostics-display, echo=FALSE, eval=use_saved_results}
knitr::kable(network_diagnostics, digits = 6)
knitr::kable(model_diagnostics, digits = 6)
knitr::kable(fatal_diagnostics)
```

```{r save-fit, eval=!use_saved_results}
    paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = ".")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

provenance <- list(
  input_file = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_step5_mlvar.rda",
  input_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(input_file)),
  primary_fit_file = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar.rda",
  primary_fit_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(primary_fit_file)),
  generating_script = "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis/S5_7_mlVAR_full_detrend.Rmd",
  helper_file = "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis/S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R",
  helper_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(helper_file)),
  fitted = timing$finished,
  sensitivity_role = paste(
    "Package-native full-detrend sensitivity; S5.2 full_detrend=FALSE",

  ),
  detrending_rule = paste(
    "mlVAR full_detrend=TRUE standardizes each node at each of the 90",
    "observation positions across participants before global scaling"
  ),
  missing_handling = paste(
    "mlVAR na.rm=TRUE; lag construction on 90-row scaffold; complete",
    "current-plus-lag augmented rows; no Kalman filtering/FIML/imputation"
  ),
  overnight_rule = "Retained through global occasion beep; no exclusion sensitivity planned",
  storage_rule = paste(
    "RDA retains mlVAR fixed/random result arrays, analyzed data, residuals,",
    "inputs, and complete diagnostic tables; the 24 full lmer objects are",
    "removed after diagnostics to avoid environment-heavy serialization"
  )
)

compact_model <- full_detrend_model
compact_model$output <- NULL

fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend <- list(
  model = compact_model,
  model_specification = model_specification,

rm(fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend)
```

```{r matched-model-gate, include=FALSE}
actual_input_keys <- c(
  "vars", "lags", "estimator", "temporal", "AR", "scaled",
  "scaleWithin", "idvar", "dayvar", "beepvar"
)
same_actual_inputs <- vapply(actual_input_keys, function(key) {
  identical(
    fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input[[key]],
    fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend$model$input[[key]]
  )
}, logical(1))

s5_7_fit_acceptance <- rbind(
  fatal_diagnostics,
  data.frame(
    criterion = c(
      "Recorded specification differs from S5.2 only at full_detrend",
      "Actual stored model inputs match S5.2 on every audited non-detrend setting",
      "S5.2 stores full_detrend=FALSE and S5.7 stores full_detrend=TRUE",
      "Global occasion beep and no supplied day boundary",
      "Full lmer objects summarized then removed from sensitivity RDA",
      "Sole-object sensitivity-fit RDA disk reload"
    ),
    passed = c(
      identical(model_specification, expected_sensitivity_specification),
      all(same_actual_inputs),
      isFALSE(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$full_detrend) &&
        isTRUE(fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend$model$input$full_detrend),
      identical(fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend$model$input$beepvar, "occasion") &&
        identical(fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend$model$input$dayvar, "DAY"),
      is.null(fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend$model$output) &&
        nrow(fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend$model_diagnostics) == 24L,
      file.exists(fit_file)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)

stopifnot(all(s5_7_fit_acceptance$passed))
```

# Edge-by-edge comparison with the primary model

This section compares the complete, unthresholded fixed networks. Temporal
rows are predictors at `t - 1` and columns are outcomes at `t`; all 144
directed coefficients are retained, including the 12 autoregressive self-loops.
For the contemporaneous and between-person networks, each of the 66 unique
undirected pairs is listed once. `Full detrend minus primary` is the signed
difference, whereas `Absolute difference` ignores direction. Relative absolute
change is descriptive and can become very large when the primary estimate is
near zero. Raw `p < .05` support changes are shown only as an audit of the
exploratory screening rule; a gain or loss of support is not itself evidence
that the two edge estimates differ statistically.

```{r build-edge-comparisons, eval=!use_saved_results}
primary_matrices <- extract_mlvar_matrices(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model)
full_detrend_matrices <- extract_mlvar_matrices(
  fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend$model
)

for (network_name in c("temporal", "contemporaneous", "between")) {
  validate_network_matrix(
    primary_matrices[[network_name]], node_names,
    symmetric = network_name != "temporal"
  )
  validate_network_matrix(
    full_detrend_matrices[[network_name]], node_names,
    symmetric = network_name != "temporal"
  )
}

support_change_label <- function(primary_supported, detrended_supported) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    primary_supported & detrended_supported ~ "Supported in both",
    primary_supported & !detrended_supported ~ "Lost after detrending",
    !primary_supported & detrended_supported ~ "Gained after detrending",
    TRUE ~ "Unsupported in both"
  )
}

add_change_metrics <- function(data) {
  data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      full_detrend_minus_primary = full_detrend_estimate - primary_estimate,
      absolute_difference = abs(full_detrend_minus_primary),
      relative_absolute_change_pct = dplyr::if_else(
        abs(primary_estimate) > sqrt(.Machine$double.eps),
        100 * absolute_difference / abs(primary_estimate),
        NA_real_
      ),
      sign_changed = primary_estimate * full_detrend_estimate < 0,
      primary_supported = primary_p < .05,
      full_detrend_supported = full_detrend_p < .05,
      support_change = support_change_label(
        primary_supported, full_detrend_supported
      )
    )
}

temporal_index <- expand.grid(
  from_index = seq_along(node_names),
  to_index = seq_along(node_names),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
temporal_comparison <- temporal_index |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    network = "Temporal",
    edge_order = dplyr::row_number(),
    from_node = node_names[from_index],
    to_node = node_names[to_index],
    from_label = dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$label[from_index],
    to_label = dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$label[to_index],
    from_community = dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$community[from_index],
    to_community = dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$community[to_index],
    edge = paste0(from_label, " (t-1) -> ", to_label, " (t)"),
    directed = TRUE,
    self_loop = from_node == to_node,
    primary_estimate = primary_matrices$temporal[cbind(from_index, to_index)],
    full_detrend_estimate = full_detrend_matrices$temporal[cbind(from_index, to_index)],
    primary_p = primary_matrices$temporal_p[cbind(from_index, to_index)],
    full_detrend_p = full_detrend_matrices$temporal_p[cbind(from_index, to_index)]
  ) |>
  add_change_metrics() |>
  dplyr::select(-from_index, -to_index)

build_undirected_comparison <- function(
  network_label, primary_weight, primary_gamma_p,
  detrended_weight, detrended_gamma_p
) {
  pair <- which(upper.tri(primary_weight), arr.ind = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    network = network_label,
    edge_order = seq_len(nrow(pair)),
    from_node = rownames(primary_weight)[pair[, 1L]],
    to_node = colnames(primary_weight)[pair[, 2L]],
    from_label = dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$label[pair[, 1L]],
    to_label = dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$label[pair[, 2L]],
    from_community = dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$community[pair[, 1L]],
    to_community = dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$community[pair[, 2L]],
    edge = paste0(
      dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$label[pair[, 1L]], " -- ",
      dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$label[pair[, 2L]]
    ),
    directed = FALSE,
    self_loop = FALSE,
    primary_estimate = primary_weight[pair],
    full_detrend_estimate = detrended_weight[pair],
    primary_p = pmax(primary_gamma_p[pair], t(primary_gamma_p)[pair]),
    full_detrend_p = pmax(
      detrended_gamma_p[pair], t(detrended_gamma_p)[pair]
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) |>
    add_change_metrics()
}

contemporaneous_comparison <- build_undirected_comparison(
  "Contemporaneous",
  primary_matrices$contemporaneous,
  primary_matrices$contemporaneous_gamma_p,
  full_detrend_matrices$contemporaneous,
  full_detrend_matrices$contemporaneous_gamma_p
)

between_comparison <- build_undirected_comparison(
  "Between-person",
  primary_matrices$between,
  primary_matrices$between_gamma_p,
  full_detrend_matrices$between,
  full_detrend_matrices$between_gamma_p
)

edge_comparisons <- list(
  Temporal = temporal_comparison,
  Contemporaneous = contemporaneous_comparison,
  Between_Person = between_comparison
)

summarize_network_change <- function(data) {
  max_index <- which.max(data$absolute_difference)
  data.frame(
    network = data$network[[1L]],
    edges = nrow(data),
    pearson_estimate_correlation = stats::cor(
      data$primary_estimate, data$full_detrend_estimate
    ),
    spearman_estimate_correlation = stats::cor(
      data$primary_estimate, data$full_detrend_estimate,
      method = "spearman"
    ),
    mean_signed_difference = mean(data$full_detrend_minus_primary),
    mean_absolute_difference = mean(data$absolute_difference),
    median_absolute_difference = stats::median(data$absolute_difference),
    root_mean_squared_difference = sqrt(mean(data$full_detrend_minus_primary^2)),
    maximum_absolute_difference = data$absolute_difference[[max_index]],
    maximum_change_edge = data$edge[[max_index]],
    sign_changes = sum(data$sign_changed),
    primary_supported_edges = sum(data$primary_supported),
    full_detrend_supported_edges = sum(data$full_detrend_supported),
    support_gained = sum(data$support_change == "Gained after detrending"),
    support_lost = sum(data$support_change == "Lost after detrending"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

network_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  edge_comparisons, summarize_network_change
))

top_changes <- dplyr::bind_rows(edge_comparisons) |>
  dplyr::group_by(network) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = absolute_difference, n = 10L, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(network, dplyr::desc(absolute_difference)) |>
  dplyr::select(
    network, edge, primary_estimate, full_detrend_estimate,
    full_detrend_minus_primary, absolute_difference,
    relative_absolute_change_pct, sign_changed, support_change
  )

knitr::kable(network_summary, digits = 6)
knitr::kable(top_changes, digits = 6)
```

```{r saved-comparison-display, echo=FALSE, eval=use_saved_results}
knitr::kable(network_summary, digits = 6)
knitr::kable(top_changes, digits = 6)
```

## Export and validate the complete edge comparisons

```{r export-edge-comparisons, eval=!use_saved_results}
workbook_sheets <- list(
  Summary = round_numeric_columns(network_summary, digits = 6L),
  Temporal = round_numeric_columns(temporal_comparison, digits = 6L),
  Contemporaneous = round_numeric_columns(
    contemporaneous_comparison, digits = 6L
  ),
  Between_Person = round_numeric_columns(between_comparison, digits = 6L)
)

# Keep workbook export in a fresh R process after mlVAR's parallel workers.
# Use openxlsx's native zip dependency, without an external zip executable or
# replacement of package bindings. The table values and styling are unchanged.
export_status <- callr::r(
  function(workbook_sheets, table_file, helper_file) {
    source(helper_file, encoding = "UTF-8")
    bruceR::export(workbook_sheets, file = table_file, overwrite = TRUE)
    style_and_sanitize_workbook(table_file, workbook_sheets)
    list(
      exists = file.exists(table_file),
      bytes = file.info(table_file)$size,
      sheets = readxl::excel_sheets(table_file)
    )
  },
  args = list(
    workbook_sheets = workbook_sheets,
    table_file = table_file,
    helper_file = normalizePath(helper_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  ),
  libpath = .libPaths(),
  spinner = FALSE
)
stopifnot(
  isTRUE(export_status$exists),
  is.finite(export_status$bytes), export_status$bytes > 0,
  identical(export_status$sheets, names(workbook_sheets))
)

sheet_names <- readxl::excel_sheets(table_file)
reloaded_sheets <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(sheet_names, function(sheet) {
    as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(table_file, sheet = sheet))
  }),
  sheet_names
)
formula_errors <- sum(vapply(reloaded_sheets, function(sheet) {
  sum(vapply(sheet, function(column) {
    sum(grepl(
      "^#(REF!|VALUE!|NAME\\?|DIV/0!|N/A)", as.character(column)
    ))
  }, integer(1)))
}, integer(1)))

comparison_gate <- data.frame(
  criterion = c(
    "Temporal table contains all 144 directed edges including 12 self-loops",
    "Contemporaneous table contains 66 unique undirected edges",
    "Between-person table contains 66 unique undirected edges",
    "All estimates, p values, and signed differences are finite",
    "Every signed difference equals full-detrend minus primary",
    "No duplicate edge keys within any network",
    "All three estimate correlations are finite",
    "Workbook has the exact four planned sheets",
    "Workbook reload preserves planned row counts",
    "Workbook contains no formula-error strings"
  ),
  passed = c(
    nrow(temporal_comparison) == 144L && sum(temporal_comparison$self_loop) == 12L,
    nrow(contemporaneous_comparison) == 66L,
    nrow(between_comparison) == 66L,
    all(vapply(edge_comparisons, function(data) {
      all(is.finite(data$primary_estimate)) &&
        all(is.finite(data$full_detrend_estimate)) &&
        all(is.finite(data$primary_p)) &&
        all(is.finite(data$full_detrend_p)) &&
        all(is.finite(data$full_detrend_minus_primary))
    }, logical(1))),
    all(vapply(edge_comparisons, function(data) {
      isTRUE(all.equal(
        data$full_detrend_minus_primary,
        data$full_detrend_estimate - data$primary_estimate,
        tolerance = 1e-12
      ))
    }, logical(1))),
    all(vapply(edge_comparisons, function(data) {
      !anyDuplicated(data[c("from_node", "to_node")])
    }, logical(1))),
    all(is.finite(network_summary$pearson_estimate_correlation)) &&
      all(is.finite(network_summary$spearman_estimate_correlation)),
    identical(
      sheet_names,
      c("Summary", "Temporal", "Contemporaneous", "Between_Person")
    ),
    identical(
      vapply(reloaded_sheets, nrow, integer(1)),
      c(Summary = 3L, Temporal = 144L, Contemporaneous = 66L, Between_Person = 66L)
    ),
    formula_errors == 0L
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (!all(comparison_gate$passed)) {
  print(comparison_gate)
  stop("S5.7 edge-comparison gate failed")
}

workbook_audit <- data.frame(
  file = "Res_3_Results/Table_S5_7_mlVAR_FullDetrendEdgeComparison.xlsx",
  sheets = length(sheet_names),
  exact_sheet_names = identical(sheet_names, names(workbook_sheets)),
  formula_errors = formula_errors,
  bytes = file.info(table_file)$size,
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(table_file)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

comparison_provenance <- list(
  primary_fit_file = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar.rda",
  primary_fit_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(primary_fit_file)),
  full_detrend_fit_file = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/fit_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend.rda",
  full_detrend_fit_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(fit_file)),
  generating_script = "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis/S5_7_mlVAR_full_detrend.Rmd",
  comparison_basis = paste(
    "Complete unthresholded fixed networks; Temporal includes 144 directed",
    "edges and each undirected network includes 66 unique pairs"
  ),
  difference_definition = "full_detrend_TRUE estimate minus primary full_detrend_FALSE estimate",
  inference_guardrail = paste(
    "Edge differences and raw-p support changes are descriptive; no paired",
    "bootstrap or direct inferential test of edge differences was performed"
  ),
  generated = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")
)

results_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend_comparison <- list(
  edge_comparisons = edge_comparisons,
  network_summary = network_summary,
  top_changes = top_changes,
  comparison_gate = comparison_gate,
  workbook_audit = workbook_audit,
  provenance = comparison_provenance
)

save(
  results_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend_comparison,

)
rm(results_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend_comparison)
results_s5_7_mlvar_full_detrend_comparison <- load_single_object(

)

stopifnot(

comparison_output_audit <- data.frame(

  ),

    "Summary plus 144/66/66 edge rows"
  ),

    file.info(comparison_result_file)$size,
    file.info(table_file)$size
  ),
```

The full-detrend edge changes are descriptive because this report does not bootstrap the
difference between the two fitted networks. The S5.2 `full_detrend = FALSE`
model and its participant-cluster uncertainty analyses remain canonical.
